questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Career opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg valgte følgende destination grundet et ønske om bedre kendskab til det norske sundhedssystem samt at blive bedre til sproget.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Dette skal ikke tolkes som at Oslo skal vælges fra på baggrund af fagligheden. Dette skyldes udelukkende dårlig administrativt arbejde mellem KU og Oslo Universitet.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var svært at få informationer omkring ankomst. Havde først endelig informationer omkring studieophold (f.eks. hvilke afdelinger man skulle på, information om MRSA test) en uge inden afrejse. Ikke særlig optimalt ift. planlægning.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Fik ingen assistance.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Er Norge har de en særdeles veletableret student organisation (SiO) hvorigennem man kan leje studiebolig, fitness, læge, børnehave osv. Kan kun anbefales! Det er fungerer!

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Jeg boede i en af SiO's studentboliger som hedder Grünerløkka studentbolig. Dette ligger centralt og det er nemt fremkommeligt til de hospitaler jeg var på. Dog skal man ikke forvente at det er et kollegie. Man har sin egen lejlighed med eget køkken og bad. De folk som bor der snakker IKKE sammen. Havde fornemmelsen af at hvis man ønskede mere kollegie følelse skulle man bo i de studentboliger som var tættere på campus.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
https://studentslippet.no
(Vildt sjove arrangement, men bliver hurtigt booket, så man skal tilmelde sig i god tid!!!). Derudover aktiviteter gennem SiO.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Andre studenter skal op i marka. Der er en masse hyggelige seter, og rig mulighed for udendørs aktivitet. Havde selv taget Gravel cykel med, kan kun anbefales!!

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Nemt, Oslo minder meget om Kbh

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer:
https://studentslippet.no
eller bo tættere oppe ved campus

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Ikke nogle.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Der tilgang til naturen og sport.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Der er meget administrativt arbejde. Det er ikke noget som man bare lige gør. Der skal ligges en masse tid i det.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Du er ikke tilknyttet et hold eller en klasse, og er hele opholdt igennem kun på en hospitalsafdeling. Derfor skal man selv være gearet på at opsøge social kontakt. Men det norske folk er søde og imødekommende specielt de yngre læger.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At opleve at bo i Norge, og tilgængeligheden til den norske natur som ikke kan sammenlignet med DK.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Det administrative arbejde mellem KU og Oslo Universitet var virkelig dårligt. Derfor skulle du som student sørger for at de fik gjort det som skulle til. I længden var dette meget belastende. Der var ikke styr på ret meget. Man skulle ikke tro de gjorde det to gange om året.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
